items.html: Rather, it too was drawn and spread downward until the navel, and it also surrounded the Nukva of ZA, which begins from the chest; and it too entered within, at the navel. Then there were found there three Mochin: Hochma, Bina, and the coronet of Gevura. And these three were clothed in the Netzah and Hod of ZA: Hochma in Netzah, and Bina and Gevura in Hod.
